structure.unit: General Provisions Relating to Social Services
Local Departments and Local Directors of Social Services

law.catch_line: Service at pleasure of local board or local director
law.text: The local director and other employees shall serve at the pleasure of the local board, or other appointing authority, subject to the provisions of the merit system plan as defined in § 63.2-100. If other employees are employed by the local director, they shall serve at the pleasure of the local director, within the provisions of the merit system plan.
